title: Zk Lancers
tagline: A decentralised and distributed Freelancing platform enabling zero-knowledge transparency and authentic business between clients and freelancers based on a reputation system.
description:
Clients and Freelancers - both encounter slew of problems:
- Time squandering
- Resources wastage
- Probability of fraud
- Lack of communication or collaboration
- Security or Authentication

ZK Lancer solves the above-mentioned problems by improving the probability of collaboration between the two parties, sending notifications in terms of decision taking for the purpose of transparency and eventually reducing the chances of potential fraud.
how_its_made:
1) Learning the knack of web3 tools quickly and integrating it proved to be a formidable challenge
2) For FVM, building on top of it was a hard nut to crack because of the lack of documentation. However, we implemented it.
3) For the Push notification system and Chat App, calling functions through smart contract was difficult due to backend issues
